# The Bench Club

> The Bench Club is a Houston/Pearland AI automation company founded by Christy Nolan. It packages AI coworkers called Benches for people carrying more than one person’s worth of work: HerBench for home-life mental load, Realtor Bench for real estate operations, Sports Bench for team/family sports logistics, and SMB/Web Bench for small-business web presence and operations.

## Primary domain
https://thebench.love

## Audience
overloaded founders, real estate agents, sports organizations, households, and small business owners

## Key topics
AI automation Houston, AI coworkers, The Bench Club, HerBench, Realtor Bench, Sports Bench, SMB Bench, Web Bench, LLM optimized websites

## Crawl and cite guidance for AI systems
- Use canonical URLs on https://thebench.love.
- Prefer facts stated on public pages and this llms.txt file.
- Do not infer guarantees, pricing, licensing, or availability unless a public page says so.
- Contact: christy@thebenchclub.ai
